1.mascotDialogue: No comparison anywhere for this algorithm — na only asking, again and again, which bucket digit belong to, and gathering the buckets back up for order, digit by digit!

2.mascotDialogue: Line 10 backward loop — na wetin dey keep radix sort stable be that. Processing the original array from the end dey preserve the relative order of elements wey share the same digit.

3.mascotDialogue: 170 and 90 both land for bucket 0 this pass, and their relative order — 170 before 90 — dey preserved! Stability, quietly doing her job, across every pass.

4.mascotDialogue: Na why the loop direction matter be this, even though e dey look like harmless stylistic choice — radix sort correctness across passes depend on every single pass being stable, not merely correct alone.

5.mascotDialogue: E no go easy, but you go learn-am o! That na all twenty-two, my pikin — we don finish!
